title: Putnami PHC Credential Digest
description: A PHC-style versioned credential digest string. Two algorithms: '$pbkdf2-sha256$v=1$i=<iterations>$<b64-salt>$<b64-hash>' and '$hmac-sha256$v=1$<b64-salt>$<b64-hash>'. Salt and hash use RFC 4648 §4 standard base64 WITHOUT padding (alphabet A-Za-z0-9+/). The version segment pins 'v=1' (DigestVersion).
